name: Sakuyamon: Maid Mode
main_effect:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may place 1 yellow Tamer card or 1 single-color Option card with a cost of 5 or less from your hand on top of your security stack.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When an Option card is used, or when a card is added to a security stack, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -6000 DP for the turn.
source_effect: Ace Overflow ＜-4＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
